title: Flights nobody booked
statementMd:
Count flights that have no bookings.

Expected columns: `empty_flights`.

Tables: `airlines`, `airports`, `flights`, `bookings`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS empty_flights FROM flights f LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.flight_id = f.id WHERE b.id IS NULL;
```
